description: Compacting a sorted map and set three levels deep, whose branches hold keys of every form as separators. A removed key's record stays, as its separator still points at it, and that's all that does, so the compactor has to copy it. A key put back has a new record beside the separator's old one. A branch that split off keeps a key in its first separator, which nothing reads, and that's copied too. Written by src/longscripts.zig.
